description:
Use this when the user wants their life as a whole: which life areas (marriage, children, career, business, money, property, family, travel, education, spirituality, health) are in focus when, across past and future, and where life stands now.
The life's chapters (each mahādaśā in plain words, with dates and ages) and eleven life areas, each with the planets that govern it on this chart, every governing period past and future with why that planet governs it — each marked `primary` (the area is in focus) or `also` (the period only touches it) — and what is in focus now and next. Past periods are included, so the reading can be tested against a life already lived; send `recorded` events to place them on the timeline. Health is read only as periods to give extra care, never as illness or lifespan. Deterministic: no language model is called. The birth time is required. The full reading is large; pass `areas` to return only the life areas you need.
Cost: 10 credits per call (only successful calls are charged; a sandbox key is free and returns a fixed sample).
Deterministic: the same input always gives the same answer.
Example arguments: {"birthData":{"date":"1990-05-12","time":"14:35","timezone":"Asia/Kolkata","latitude":28.6139,"longitude":77.209},"areas":["career","relationship"],"recorded":[{"type":"job_start","date":"2012-07-01","certainty":"exact"},{"type":"marriage","date":"2018-11-25","certainty":"exact"}]}

areas.description: Optional: only these life areas (default all eleven). The full reading is large, so an AI agent answering about one area should pass it here.

birthData.description: The person's birth data. The time is required: every period depends on the rising sign.

time.description: 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, local to `timezone`. Omit if unknown: house-dependent detail is then reduced.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the birthplace, e.g. Asia/Kolkata.

recorded.description: Optional dated life events to place on the timeline.

name: get_life_reading

requestId.description: Quote this in any support request.

sandbox.description: Present and true only on sandbox-key responses: a fixed sample, not computed from your request.

areas.description: Eleven life areas, each with what governs it and every period, past and future.

classicalSources.description: Titles of the classical books the area draws on.

because.description: Why this planet governs the area on this chart, e.g. "lord of the 7th".

care.description: Health only, in-focus periods only: the body areas the tradition links to the period and the matching check-up. Not repeated in `words`.

classical.description: The classical grounds behind the period, in plain words: the chapter (mahādaśā) lord, the period lord's nakṣatra (star) lord and its full aspect, where they bear on this area. Not repeated in `words`.

focus.description: primary: the area is in focus (the period lord rules or occupies the area's primary house, or is its natural significator; a node acts for its sign lord). also: the period only touches the area through a wider significator. `now`, `next` and the summary use primary periods only.

shownFromAge.description: Periods before this age are not shown for the area.

chapters.description: The life's chapters: each mahādaśā with its dates, ages and what it stands for.

recorded.description: Your recorded events, each with the chapter and period running when it happened and the areas it belongs to.

summary.description: Where the life stands now, in everyday words.

remaining_credits.description: Your one-time free credits left plus the paid balance, after this call.

title: Whole-life reading
